title: S53 — Hard CAPTCHA generator: synthesize thousands of degraded images for training and testing
desc:
Current limitation: we only have 3 seed images worth of hard cases (100 items in each suite). The CNN can't learn to read degraded glyphs if it never sees enough examples. S29/S30 showed the wall is image-side — the CNN needs MORE hard training data.

Task: extend generator.py to synthesize thousands of hard CAPTCHAs with controlled degradation patterns:

1. **Corrosion variations** (500 images):
   - Light: 50-100 pits, minimal stroke thickening
   - Medium: 100-200 pits, moderate stroke thickening
   - Heavy: 200-300 pits, severe stroke thickening
   - Extreme: 300+ pits, near-illegible

2. **Rotation variations** (500 images):
   - Mild: ±3°
   - Moderate: ±5° to ±10°
   - Severe: ±10° to ±15°
   - Extreme: ±15° to ±20°

3. **Overlay families** (500 images):
   - Spiderweb (fine lines over text)
   - Cross-shadow (dark shadows crossing text)
   - Strippy (horizontal/vertical stripes)
   - Darts (small arrows/shapes over text)

4. **Combined degradations** (500 images):
   - Corrosion + rotation
   - Corrosion + overlay
   - Rotation + overlay
   - All three combined

Total: 2000 hard CAPTCHAs with known ground truth.

Output format:
- images/ directory with PNG files
- manifest.jsonl with id, label, family, degradation_type, severity
- Use same format as existing suites (easy/hard)

This data will be used for:
- Training the v5 CNN (Cormac's S30 retrain)
- Benchmarking with larger sample size (2000 items instead of 100)
- Understanding which degradation patterns hurt most

Owner: cormac (image-side specialist, already working on S30). Priority: 1 (critical path to 95%). Parent: t-20261011-88dc.
